why: Women's day, cocktail and evening dresses, separates, bridal, swim and convertible jewelry, mostly $230–$500, sold online, in its showroom and through boutiques.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 2015 by Alessandra Perez-Rubio; Louisa Rechter.
